entities.summary: Angelo Motta was an Italian entrepreneur and founder of the food company Motta. He is associated with the commercial production of the sweet yeast bread panettone. Angelo Motta was a performers & entertainers from Gessate (1890-09-08, Gessate–1957-12-26). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
